findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_vendors · Private data: get_guest_travel_estimate, get_packing_list, create_my_wedding, list_my_guests, get_my_guest, add_my_guest, update_my_guest · Public sink: search_vendors, create_my_wedding, update_my_wedding, add_my_guest · Destructive: remove_my_guest, remove_my_event, remove_my_accommodation, remove_my_place.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_vendors · Private data: get_guest_travel_estimate, get_packing_list, create_my_wedding, list_my_guests, get_my_guest, add_my_guest, update_my_guest · Public sink: search_vendors, create_my_wedding, update_my_wedding, add_my_guest · Destructive: remove_my_guest, remove_my_event, remove_my_accommodation, remove_my_place

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
